facts.fact: NatCA's NIN-SIM project coordinator said a technical committee had integrated NCRA's database with mobile operators' systems, enabling real-time cross-checking of subscriber information.
facts.system: NIN-SIM integration (NCRA database link to operators)

systems.owner: NCRA, NatCA and mobile network operators

SLE.note: No link between the civil register and the ID system is stated.
No digital civil registration system is stated.

facts.fact: NCRA Director General Mohamed Mubashir Massaquoi said Sierra Leone has already captured around 93% of its population in the national database.

SLE.note: No number at birth is stated.
Nothing on who builds, operates or owns the system.
Only SIM registration against the ID is stated, which is not a public register keyed on the number.

facts.fact: NCRA's Director General said around 93% of the population is in the national database, and the NatCA project coordinator said national ID cards are now mandatory for obtaining SIM cards.

NCRA, NatCA and mobile network operators signed an MOU and SLA on 19 August 2025 for NIN-SIM integration, after the technical committee had integrated NCRA's database with operators' systems for real-time cross-checking of subscribers, and national ID cards are now mandatory for obtaining SIM cards.

systems.owner: NCRA, NatCA and mobile network operators
